title: Volume & capacity
sentences: Volume is the space occupied by an object; capacity is the amount a container can hold.
To calculate usable capacity, use the container's internal dimensions.
A fill fraction describes how much of that capacity is in use.
One cubic meter equals 1,000 liters, and one cubic centimeter equals one milliliter.
A tank has internal dimensions 2 m × 1 m × 1 m and is 75% full.
spoken: Volume is the space occupied by an object; capacity is the amount a container can hold.
